title: 19-21 South Washington Street (Commercial Building), Tiffin, Seneca County, OH
notes: Significance: The building was built as an addition to the Tiffin Woolen Mills, according to the Ohio Historic Trust Inventory. It exemplifies late 19th early 20th century brick manufacturing/commercial structures.
